close_reason: Fixed by commits 2761dea (add jmap_types::methods module) + 4bf3a25 (migrate 7 client crates). SetError now has all 8 RFC 8620 §5.3 fields plus a serde-flatten 'extra' map for extension fields. The 5 response shapes are defined once in jmap-types and re-exported by all 7 jmap-*-client crates. Net -697 LOC across the client crates. 1424 workspace tests pass.
description:
Each client crate independently defines its own copies of `GetResponse<T>`, `SetResponse`, `ChangesResponse`, `QueryResponse`, `QueryChangesResponse` in methods/mod.rs. ~35 redundant struct definitions across the workspace.

Drift has already started: server's `SetError` (8 fields) and client's `SetError` (2 fields) are now divergent (see JMAP-sc1b.X).

These shapes are RFC 8620 §5 normative — they apply to every JMAP method. They should live in exactly one place.

Options:
1. Add to `jmap-types` (LOCKED — needs Mark's approval). Most natural home given the crate's purpose.
2. Add to `jmap-base-client` (LOCKED — needs Mark's approval). Constrains type crates from using them, but the type crates currently don't.
3. New `jmap-rfc8620-method-shapes` crate. Awkward but unblocks editing.

Once they live in one place, the 7 client crates re-export instead of redefining.

Action ordering: file with Mark's approval to expand jmap-types or jmap-base-client public API; then PR the change once approved.
title: P1: 5 RFC 8620 generic response shapes duplicated across 7 client crates (~35 redundant struct defs)
